description: -40℃~+150℃ 1 22V 2A 5.5V~65V 580kHz Analog、PWM Buck Built-in DC-DC Over-Temperature Protection (OTP) MSOP-10-EP LED Drivers ROHS
topology: inductive buck CC, internal 2 A NFET, hysteretic constant-off-time
pwm_evidence: EC: tPWM(uvlo) PWM rising -> SW rising 75 ns typ / 130 ns max; PWM falling -> SW falling 100 ns typ / 170 ns max. tLEB minimum ON-time (minimum pulse width) 75 / 195 / 275 ns. s8.3.11: 'if a 10 kHz PWM frequency is desired having a period of 100 us, the minimum duty cycle is 200 ns/100 us = 0.2%. This is sometimes referred to as 500:1 dimming.' Features list: '1000:1 PWM Dimming Range' and '10,000:1 Shunt PWM Dimming Range'. Caveat in the same section: 'Standard PWM frequency ranges can also be used (100 Hz to 2 kHz). When using higher frequencies the delays from PWM to gate turn ON and turn OFF can begin to limit the achievable duty cycle.' PWM pin also has a 100 uA pulldown that guarantees zero glow when low.

description: -40℃~+125℃ 1 1A 250kHz~1MHz 3% 4.5V~65V Analog、PWM Buck Built-in DC-DC Over-Temperature Protection (OTP) SOIC-8-EP LED Drivers ROHS

This enables the LM3414/HV to achieve high-speed dimming and very fine dimming control'; 'TI recommends setting the dimming frequency not higher than 1/10 of the switching frequency. description: -40℃~+125℃ 9V~75V Analog、PWM Buck External Over-Temperature Protection (OTP) HVSSOP-10-EP-0.5mm LED Drivers ROHS

pwm_evidence: Features: '10,000:1 PWM Dimming Range'. EC: tON-MIN 115 ns typ / 211 ns max. s8.3.6 PWM Dimming Using the EN Pin: 'The enable pin (EN) is a TTL compatible input for PWM dimming'; 'While the EN pin is in a logic low state the support circuitry (driver, bandgap, VCC regulator) remains active to minimize the time needed to turn the LED array back on'; 'The LED current rise and fall times (which are limited by the slew rate of the inductor as well as the delay from activation of the EN pin to the response of the external PFET) limit the achievable TDIM and DDIM. description: -25℃~+85℃ 1.2A 1MHz 5% 6V~30V Analog、PWM Buck Built-in DC-DC Over-Temperature Protection (OTP) SOT-89-5 LED Drivers ROHS
topology: inductive buck CC, internal switch, SOT-89-5
pwm_evidence: EC: fDIM (Maximum PWM dimming frequency) 20 kHz; DPWM_LF low-frequency PWM duty range 0.02% at fDIM = 100 Hz, dimming ratio 5000:1; DPPWM_HF high-frequency PWM duty range 4% at fDIM = 20 kHz, dimming ratio 25:1. RDIM internal pull-up 200 kohm to 4.2 V; VDIM_H 2.5 V for full current, off below 0.3 V. 4% of the 50 us period at 20 kHz = 2 us minimum on-time, so at 9.766 kHz (102.4 us) the floor is ~2% duty, ~50:1, i.e. about 5.6 usable bits - not 13.

description: -40℃~+85℃ 0V~5.5V 2.7V~5.5V 24 25.5mA、35mA 29kHz 7% I2C Over-Temperature Protection (OTP) VQFN-32-EP(4x4) LED Drivers ROHS
verdict: PWM source only, not a power driver
topology: 24-channel I2C linear current sink with a LOCAL 12-bit PWM generator per channel
pwm_evidence: EC: fPWM PWM switching frequency 21 - 29 kHz. s7.3.1.3: 'The final output PWM duty cycle has 12 bits of control accuracy, which is achieved by a 9 bits of pure PWM resolution and 3 bits of digital dithering control ... When disabled, the output PWM duty-cycle accuracy is 9 bits.' 25.5 mA/ch max (35 mA when VCC >= 3.3 V), VSAT 0.25-0.4 V, outputs abs-max 5.5 V. Cannot drive 150 mA - 1 A LEDs at any string voltage this board uses; only usable as a local PWM SOURCE feeding four driver DIM pins, and that does not fix the driver's own settling limit.

description: -40℃~+85℃ 175mA 2% 25V 3V~5.5V 4 Over-Temperature Protection (OTP) PWM SOIC-8 LED Drivers ROHS
rail: LED pins to 25 V, VCC 3-5.5 V
pwm_evidence: PWM timing NOT VERIFIED in this run (onsemi PDF download blocked; LCSC parametrics only say 'PWM'). Rejected on a structural ground that does not need the timing: the package has ONE shared EN/PWM pin for all four outputs, so one device cannot give four independent R/G/B/W channels. Using four devices with their four outputs paralleled would give ~700 mA/channel but is a linear sink - see the dissipation arithmetic in led-driver.md s4.

description: -40℃~+125℃ 1 150mA 1V~60V 3% 3.5V~60V Built-in PWM MSOP-8-EP LED Drivers ROHS

description: -40℃~+125℃ 1.05V、1.65V、2V、2.05V、2.25V 1.08V~2V 1.2V~3.6V 120mV~800mV 2 24mA 24mA 300mV、650mV、800mV 4 4.1ns@3.3V,50pF 40uA 74LVC Series AND Gate SOIC-14 Logic Gates ROHS
verdict: SUPPORT PART - required by every candidate above
topology: quad 2-input AND gate: ENABLE AND PWMn -> driver DIM/PWM/EN pin
pwm_evidence: Not a driver. Listed because NO viable candidate has an EN/SHDN pin SEPARATE from its PWM/dimming pin - on TPS92515, LM3414, LM3409, AL8863 and PT4115 the dimming pin IS the enable pin. The ICD's active-HIGH ENABLE therefore has to be AND-ed with each PWM line (4 gates = 1 package) or the driver input rail has to be switched. tPD 4.1 ns @ 3.3 V / 50 pF is negligible against 102.4 us. Single-gate alternative if placement prefers it: SN74LVC1G08DBVR (C7666, in stock, $0.054).

description: -40℃~+85℃ 1 1.5A 1MHz 4.5V~40V 5% Analog、PWM Buck Built-in DC-DC Over-Temperature Protection (OTP)、Short-Circuit  Protection MSOP-8-EP LED Drivers ROHS
topology: inductive buck CC, internal switch (family: AL8860 C500782, AL8862 C526360/C510554)
pwm_evidence: s'PWM Dimming': 'To achieve a high resolution, the PWM frequency is recommended to be lower than 500Hz, however higher dimming frequencies can be used at the expense of dimming dynamic range and accuracy.' Pin table: 'Linear adjustment ranges from 1% to 100% of IOUTNOM for f < 500Hz'. Built-in soft-start: 'Default soft-start time = 0.1ms' - 100 us, i.e. essentially the entire 102.4 us period at 9.766 kHz. AL8860 and AL8862 carry identical wording and the identical 0.1 ms soft-start.

description: -40℃~+125℃ 1 1A 1MHz 2% 6V~60V Analog、PWM Buck Built-in Built-in soft-start DC-DC TSOT-25 LED Drivers ROHS
topology: inductive buck CC, internal switch, ADJ pin
pwm_evidence: The EC parameter DPWM(LF) is specified only 'during low frequency PWM dimming mode, PWM frequency <300Hz' (duty 0.001-1, brightness control range 1000:1). Shutdown: 'Taking the ADJ pin to a voltage below 0.2V for more than approximately 100us will turn off the output'. tSS soft start 2 ms (with the recommended 22 nF). At 9.766 kHz the ADJ low interval never reaches 100 us below ~98% duty, so the internal low-pass filter converts the PWM into ANALOGUE current dimming - which also violates PAR-REQ-08 (chromaticity must not shift).

description: -40℃~+85℃ 1 154kHz~1MHz 5% 6V~40V 750mA Buck Built-in DC-DC Over-Temperature Protection (OTP)、LED open-circuit protection PWM SOT-89-5 LED Drivers ROHS
topology: inductive buck CC, internal switch, ADJ pin (ZXLD1362-class)
pwm_evidence: EC table, and this is the cleanest number in the whole survey: DPWM(LF) dimming ratio 1200:1 at PWM frequency = 100 Hz, but DPWM(HF) dimming ratio 13:1 at PWM frequency = 10 kHz (both at 5 V PWM amplitude, VIN = 15 V, 1 LED). 13:1 at 10 kHz is about 3.7 usable bits. TPD internal comparator delay 50 ns, TONmin 200 ns - the IC is fast; the CONTROL PATH is what is slow, which is the trap this whole class sets.

description: -40℃~+125℃ 1 100Hz~200Hz 2.5V~60V 20mA 5% 60V External Over-Temperature Protection (OTP) PWM SOD-123 LED Drivers ROHS
pwm_evidence: s'PWM Dimming': dimming requires an external MOSFET on the Out pin, 'applying a PWM signal with a frequency range between 100Hz and 200Hz'.
